source_studied.limitation: Checkout is not proven to be the exact package revision.

window: max(trend period, configured body period, 20)+1 prior candles suffice for long-body qualification at i-2, middle-body/doji and trend ending at i-1. Bounded engine period adds the current bar. Extreme periods that would overflow retain ordinary shared-state fallback.
native_contract: Raw public tuple/generic APIs in 20-output blocks with 21 seed candles (default body=20, trend=3), serial loop versus up to eight workers. Inputs/segments prepared outside timing; raw nullable Boolean lists returned without normalization. Full builder additionally owns OHLCV snapshots. MorningDojiStar uses the generic public class; MoringinDojiStar benchmarks the published misspelled tuple alias separately.
setup_checks: Full-data independent exact and native-decimal references, exact nullable startup mask, true/false outcomes, native serial/parallel equality, unpartitioned ordinary-native prefix, both history modes and ordinary evaluator. Existing fixtures include strict midpoint/doji/gap boundaries; this workload matches both references, without asserting universal binary64/decimal equality.
result: Both builder history modes have nonoverlapping-interval wins against both tested native paths at both 1k and 10k. Coverage increases from 80 to 87 APIs (six variants plus a native alias).
scope: CPU bounded replay only. Variable-anchor three-methods patterns were inspected and deliberately excluded from finite-window eligibility. Their remaining rollout needs a different state strategy.
